title: Design System: Guilherme Campos — Personal Portfolio

display.purpose: Page-level H1. One scale on every route.

headline.purpose: Section H2 inside SectionHeader; smaller than Display on purpose.

label.purpose: Short uppercase structural labels inside project detail cards only.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, GlassCard subtitles, form text.

shadows.name: hairline-lift
shadows.purpose: Outline button variant only. Not used elsewhere.

motion.name: press-feedback
motion.value: scale(1.05) on hover, scale(0.97) on active, transition-transform
motion.purpose: System-wide button and nav-link interaction. Should live in the Button variant, not per call site.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for reveals and state transitions; no bounce/elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.491 0.27 292.581); color: oklch(0.969 0.016 293.756); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: calc(0.625rem - 2px); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.432 0.232 292.759); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.723 0.014 214.4 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.148 0.004 228.8); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: calc(0.625rem - 2px); border: 1px solid oklch(0.925 0.005 214.3); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.963 0.002 197.1); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Glass Subtitle Card
components.description: The system's one glass moment — frames a section subtitle beneath a SectionHeader H2.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { border-radius: calc(0.625rem + 4px); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.6); padding: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Nav Pill Link
components.description: Desktop navigation item; active/hover state is a pill, not an underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: calc(0.625rem - 2px); border: 1px solid oklch(0.925 0.005 214.3); background: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: oklch(0.963 0.002 197.1); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-nav-link[data-active='true'] { background: oklch(0.963 0.002 197.1); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.148 0.004 228.8); border: 1px solid oklch(0.925 0.005 214.3); border-radius: calc(0.625rem - 2px); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.723 0.014 214.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.723 0.014 214.4 / 0.5); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.56 0.021 213.5); }

narrative.overview: Every visible choice reads like a compiled output, not a decorative pass: one violet signal fires with precision against a cool, neutral canvas, and nothing is on the page without a reason. The palette recently moved its neutrals (borders, rings, muted text) off a purple-tinted gray and onto a cool slate family — the violet no longer bleeds into surfaces it doesn't own. Motion (GSAP/Motion/Three.js) exists to demonstrate technical precision, not to perform for its own sake. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS-AI template: no gradient text, no nested cards, no uppercase eyebrow above every section, no hero-metric-plus-gradient block, no bounce/elastic easing. Glass is used exactly once, as a deliberate framing device — not as decorative texture spread across the UI.
keyCharacteristics: One committed accent (Signal Violet) carrying primary actions and data viz; everything else is a cool, near-achromatic neutral.
Flat-by-default surfaces; a single glass-framed component (not a system-wide material).
Poppins for headings, Inter for body — an existing, committed pairing; not re-litigated here.
Fluid, clamp()-driven type scale so hierarchy never jumps at a breakpoint.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet appears only where an action or data point is genuinely primary. Borders, rings, and muted text are cool-slate, never a tinted-down violet.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Every H1 across the site uses the same clamp() value. A page whose hero reads smaller than its siblings is a bug.

rules.name: The One Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-blur appears in exactly one component (GlassCard, subtitle framing). It is not the default treatment for cards, panels, or navigation.

dos: Do keep Signal Violet to primary actions, active states, and the chart ramp.
Do use the same clamp() Display scale for every page's H1; the same Headline scale for every SectionHeader.
Do centralize the hover-scale (1.05) / press-scale (0.97) behavior in the Button variant.
Do reserve backdrop-blur for GlassCard's subtitle framing.
donts: Don't add an uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing on any transition.
Don't let a neutral element drift back toward a purple tint.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe.
